purpose: Discovery catalogue for current Human Record entries. This is routing metadata, not a universal record schema, evidence upgrade or certification surface.
view_basis_policy: Each human view is a derived reading surface. source_git_blobs identify the exact Markdown/JSON record bytes the view was aligned to. If either underlying source blob changes without a corresponding view-basis update, view freshness is unestablished. A blob match establishes byte identity, not truth.

records.title: Winslow Homer, Camp Fire (1880)
records.known_summary: The Human Record reconciled eight identity fields against The Metropolitan Museum of Art public record, observed byte-identical museum/PSFH image streams, and now carries a bounded Met-reported Clarke → 1899 sale/agent → Pomeroy → 1927 gift collection history with selected 1893/1911 historical re-observations.
records.unknown_summary: Ownership/custody before Thomas B. Clarke, continuous physical custody/legal title across the reported 1880–1927 route, exact 1899 transfer mechanics, independent proof of the 1880 creation event, and usefulness for contemporary human/synthetic ambiguity remain unestablished.

records.title: The '80% of German flak crews died' claim
records.known_summary: A visible online propagation chain is partially reconstructed; downstream repetition is not independent corroboration. Checked historical material includes bounded German flak-personnel context, a Westermann RAF/Bomber Command phrase-level analogue ('up to 80 percent of flak casualties') whose underlying ORS S-91 citation route is identified but uninspected, and an Overmans publisher preview of a scope-relevant WASt-based military-loss study; none establishes the claimed aggregate mortality rate or a transmission path.
records.unknown_summary: The true aggregate rate, any earlier source for the 80% figure, the exact transmission path into the viral claim, the uninspected wording/data in ORS Report S-91, authentication/underlying archive support for selected Westermann passages, the uninspected values/any flak-specific breakdown in Overmans, and whether the phrase-level analogue reflects any actual source ancestry remain unresolved.

records.title: Sieve and riddle making returns from extinction
records.known_summary: Public sources show a reported last maker, extinction/revival, and for Steve Overthrow reported learning components including research, trial-and-error/product development and Mike Turnock advice/tuition; exact sequence/overlap remain unresolved. Heritage Crafts currently reports the craft as critically endangered.
records.unknown_summary: The exact tacit content, timing, relative contribution and completeness of the Turnock-to-Overthrow transfer remain unresolved, as does Colin Davies's learning route beyond the reported public-attention pathway.
records.strongest_owner: Heritage Crafts for current UK craft status and safeguarding.
records.consent_boundary: Public-source lineage only; named living practitioners were not contacted and no endorsement or private/tacit process material is claimed.

records.title: Hannibal: the person and the accounts that remain
records.known_summary: Two checked ancient-text reading surfaces preserve attributed claims and source-critical boundaries without treating the surviving accounts as the historical person or as independent corroboration by count.
records.unknown_summary: Complete source genealogy, much Carthaginian/Punic evidence, manuscript/critical-edition verification, the exact Alpine pass and many biographical disputes remain outside this bounded record.
records.strongest_owner: Classical source criticism, critical editions and specialist ancient-history scholarship own historical reconstruction; THR preserves a cross-record evidence route and correction surface only.
